info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Create Wholesale Trading Program Trading-spec
info.description: The Wholesale Trading Program Management API facilitates the creation and management of wholesale trading programs within a banking environment. This endpoint allows users to establish new trading specifications tailored to their business needs, ensuring streamlined operations. Typical consumers of this API include trading firms and financial institutions looking to optimize their trading strategies. By leveraging this API, businesses can enhance their trading capabilities and gain a competitive edge in the market.
